For the target video, at 0.00 seconds, <Picture 1> is fully referenced. Keep these exact human actors, faces, black hair, costumes, sunlight and rocky valley. integrated_multimodal_description: Vegeta steps inside Goku's reaching jab, knocks the jab aside and snaps a rear straight into the abdomen, immediately recovering that fist into a short lead hook to the jaw. Goku folds from the body hit, turns with the hook and scrambles backward on moving feet. Vegeta pursues through the recoil instead of waiting for Goku to reset. Goku slips a follow-up, tries a short counter to create space; Vegeta catches it on his forearm, pivots outside and drives a compact knee into Goku's abdomen. Goku's raised elbows arrive late; his torso buckles after the knee lands. Vegeta retracts, plants, and drives a straight kick into the chest. Goku is knocked several steps backward through gravel, loses his base and catches himself on one hand and a knee. Vegeta closes the distance while Goku urgently tries to stand. The combination, evasions, pursuit and recovery form one uninterrupted struggle, with quick strikes and brief contacts. No prolonged fist-to-body pushing, synchronized swaying or returns to starting guard. Weighted footwork, hip rotation, visible impact then recoil, dust thrown by landings. No aura or energy attacks yet.

Camera: one physical tracking shot that retreats with Goku, makes a low forty-five-degree arc around the exchange and pulls wider with the final kick. Change angle and distance with their momentum, retaining the mountain on the right and the distant stone spire. Read the fists, feet, contacts and backward displacement. Foreground stones pass against the distant terrain. No slow motion, cuts or flashes hiding contact.

overall_soundscape: Native H3 heavy dry impacts synchronized to visible contacts, bootfalls, gritty skids, cloth, armor and wind. Low instrumental tension underneath. No dialogue, voices, grunts, screams, singing or vocal breathing.

[Human realism direction]
Preserve the reference identity, age, facial proportions, skin tone, costume and lighting. Natural skin microtexture, subtle pores, varied roughness and realistic highlights; natural eyes, muscle tension and expressions. Avoid waxy or plastic skin, beauty smoothing and airbrushed faces. Preserve the requested camera behavior; realism does not require camera shake.

[Combat physical direction]
Execute only the specified choreography, attacks, defenses, powers and outcome. Preserve each actor's identity, weapon ownership, geography and accumulated damage. Physical chain for every exchange: anticipation, ground-supported propulsion through legs and hips, trajectory, visible contact or evasion, momentum transfer, displacement, reaction, recovery. A block redirects momentum; a miss carries inertia. Balance, friction, traction, gravity and center of mass govern motion. Reactions caused by impacts start after contact; anticipatory defenses remain allowed. Feet step, pivot, skid or drag visibly, never slide rigidly. Grapples require grip, tension and leverage; jumps require compression, takeoff, ballistic travel and landing. Cloth, hair and loose material follow bodies with delayed secondary motion; environmental response follows the impact. Keep attack lines, contact and body displacement readable in the requested camera. Continue motion between actions without automatic guard resets, freeze poses, teleporting, limb fusion or interpenetration. No artificial slow motion or speed ramps unless requested. No flashes, cuts or camera shake to conceal missing contact. Finish requested attacks before any subsequent dialogue, preserving the exact dialogue and requested audio. Do not invent extra opponents, injuries, dialogue or soundtracks. Follow the requested intensity and the character's established abilities.
